game_concept: A puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Northern Wall, the northern wall: the innkeeper must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Spell Forge: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against blizzard sprites.
theme: Snowy Hold – Northern Wall: the northern wall
core_gameplay_loop: In Northern Wall, repeat each round: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against blizzard sprites. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the spells value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the watch bell using at most 18 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The watch bell reached with actions_used <= 18.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 18 before the watch bell is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 9 (extended tier): Spell Forge
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Spell Forge' (Week 6 slot 1), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Northern Wall'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how spells changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against blizzard sprites in Northern Wall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The watch bell reached with actions_used <= 18.
